Name: Planar Despair
Note: Own five-basic-type scaling; symmetric negative stats, no own team buff.

Name: Jodah's Codex
Note: Activated draw; domain reduces generic activation cost, not a basic land type by itself.

Name: Wandering Stream
Note: Domain-dependent life gain; minimum three life depends on available types.

Name: Argothian Enchantress
Note: Own draw only when casting an enchantment; shroud blocks own targeted equip.

Name: Artifist Acumen
Note: Draw and temporary first strike for own team; a token-payoff label does not guarantee tokens.

Name: Arwen's Gift
Note: Scry then draw is own draw, not discard or graveyard setup.

Name: Bronzeplate Boar
Note: Reconfigure changes creature/equipment status; not an ordinary equip ability.

Name: Field-Tested Frying Pan
Note: Own Food artifact and Halfling creature are distinct token types; automatic attach only on entry.

Name: Concealed Weapon
Note: Equipment and disguise; face-down characteristics and turning face up are not modeled.

Name: Waveskimmer Aven
Note: Flying solo attacker with exalted.

Name: Dawnray Archer
Note: Exalted; activated damage restricted to attacking or blocking creature.

Name: Sigiled Behemoth
Note: Exalted creature without inherent evasion.

Name: Apostle of Purifying Light
Note: Exile from any graveyard is interaction, not own graveyard setup or recursion.

Name: Argivian Find
Note: Own artifact/enchantment card to hand, not creature recursion.

Name: Armored Scrapgorger
Note: Exile from any graveyard is not own graveyard payoff; mana output not a casting cost.

Name: Anowon, the Ruin Sage
Note: Each player sacrifices non-Vampire; own suitable creature may not exist. Not a repeatable at-will outlet.

Name: Balduvian Atrocity
Note: Conditional kicked recursion of mana value at most three; delayed sacrifice of returned creature.

Name: Arcum Dagsson
Note: Target artifact-creature controller sacrifices; can target own, conditional controller and library target.

Name: Artistic Process
Note: One mutually exclusive token mode; damage modes not simultaneous.

Name: Ajani Resolute
Note: Conditional loyalty token and eventual emblem team buff; quoted granted abilities need nested scope.

Name: Ajani Fells the Godsire
Note: Chapter II creates own creature; chapter timing and counters not interpreted.
